sidecar_not_edit: The frozen transcription JSON is NEVER edited; its hash is published. This sidecar supersedes specific claims in and about it (R6).

t1_limits.statement: T1 validates only broad two-sided price coherence. It detects some gross price errors, does not validate line values, and cannot establish digit-perfect transcription.
t1_limits.demonstration: Misreading Imai DK over +124 as +134 yields hold 4.1%, inside the 2-12% tolerance -> passes T1. The posted LINE never enters the hold formula, so a wrong line with correct prices passes T1 entirely.
t1_limits.supersedes: 'Since the pairs were transcribed independently, a misread digit would almost certainly have broken one. This is the strongest available evidence the transcription is accurate.' (findings doc section 4, and the equivalent implication wherever T1 is cited)

reader_independence.detail: The original extraction, the T4 re-read of the firing rows, and the 2026-07-28 audit full-board re-read were all performed by the same model family. The image is primary evidence; repeated extraction by one reader family is not independent verification.
reader_independence.path_to_strengthen: A human re-read or genuinely independent extraction can raise transcription confidence. It cannot repair the C5 item-5 (visible date) failure retrospectively.
